info.description: Every route a STACK engine serves, generated from the routes and the schemas the engine runs. The text that says what the routes have in common (the error envelope, authentication, the step-up for governance actions, refusals) is in SPEC.md beside this file.

bearerAuth.description: An API key (`sk_live_...`), an OAuth access token, a dashboard session or an agent credential, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Error.description: Any other error. The body is the error envelope.

Unauthorized.description: No credential, or one the server does not accept: `error.code` is `INVALID_API_KEY`.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every error answer: one object with one property, `error`.

code.description: A stable code in upper case with underscores. A client decides what to do by the code, never by the message.

message.description: A sentence for a person. It can change between versions.

details.description: Fields that depend on the code. Absent when a code has none. Never a secret, a credential or text a caller sent.

headers.description: Extra headers (auth headers will be stripped)

query.description: Query parameters to append to URL

connection.description: Which connection of the service to use, by name or id. Needed only when the account holds more than one.

target.description: For http_call: the granted service SLUG (e.g. 'stripe'), NOT a URL — put the URL in parameters.url. For mcp_tool: tool URI. For skill_invocation: skill_id. For onchain_tx: contract address.
